C-Blosc 1.21.6, compiled by the blosc-src crate from its bundled sources
https://github.com/Blosc/c-blosc

blosc-src does not package C-Blosc's LICENSE.txt or its LICENSES directory,
so MeteoCore keeps them here. The texts below are copied unmodified from the
v1.21.6 tag of C-Blosc, the release blosc-src bundles, and
scripts/third_party_notices.sh fails when blosc-src bundles another release.
The other files in that LICENSES directory cover libraries blosc-src does not
compile: LZ4, Snappy, zlib and Zstandard come from their own crates, listed
separately, and STDINT.txt covers a header used only by compilers older than
Visual Studio 2010.
